intro.title: You are king
intro.text: The old king is dead. Now you are king. You have 10 years to show what kind of king you are.

5.title: Halfway
5.text: Half your time is gone. People are starting to talk about how you rule.

10.title: The last year
10.text: This is your last year. Make it count.

omens.title: Traders
omens.text: Traders want to buy land by the river. They will pay a lot.

choices.label: Sell 40 acres
choices.then: The traders pay you 1,200 bushels.

choices.label: Say no
choices.then: The traders move on.

omens.title: The priests
omens.text: The priests want grain to build a new altar. Your people are watching.

choices.label: Give 200 bushels
choices.then: People hear you are kind. 8 new people move in.

choices.label: Say no
choices.then: The priests are angry. 5 people leave with them.

omens.title: At the gate
omens.text: A flood wrecked a town up the river. Families are waiting at your gate.

choices.label: Let them in
choices.then: 15 people join your city. They can work, but they need to eat.

choices.label: Send them away
choices.then: They walk on. The gate closes.

omens.title: Cats for sale
omens.text: A trader is selling cats. Cats hunt rats.

choices.label: Buy cats for 150 bushels
choices.then: The cats guard the grain. No rats this year.

choices.label: Keep your grain
choices.then: The trader leaves with his cats.

omens.title: The river is rising
omens.text: The river is rising. You can pay to fix the walls that hold it back.

choices.label: Fix the walls for 200 bushels
choices.then: The walls hold. Your fields stay dry.

choices.label: Do nothing
choices.then: The river floods your low fields. You lose some land.

omens.title: A greedy king
omens.text: A king nearby wants you to pay him. He has an army.

choices.label: Pay 300 bushels
choices.then: His men take the grain and go.

choices.label: Say no
choices.then: Nothing happens. This time.

gamble.then: His army takes 100 acres from you.

omens.title: A party
omens.text: Your people want a big party after the harvest.

choices.label: Throw a party for 300 bushels
choices.then: The party is so good that 10 visitors stay for good.

choices.label: Not this year
choices.then: Everyone goes back to work.

omens.title: Better seed
omens.text: A farmer is selling better seed. He says it grows more grain.

choices.label: Buy seed for 250 bushels
choices.then: You plant the new seed. Each acre gives 1 more bushel this year.

choices.label: Keep the old seed
choices.then: The farmer leaves.

omens.title: The star reader
omens.text: A woman who reads the stars says she knows how the harvest will go. She wants to be paid.

choices.label: Pay 100 bushels
choices.then: She looks at the sky.

choices.label: Say no
choices.then: She packs up her maps.

omens.title: A thief
omens.text: Your helper was caught stealing grain. He says sorry and promises to work harder.

choices.label: Kick him out
choices.then: He leaves at night. You find 150 bushels in his house.

choices.label: Forgive him
choices.then: He works day and night. You gain 30 acres of new fields.

epilogues.A+: You were a great king. Almost nobody went hungry, and there is plenty of land for everyone.
epilogues.B: You did okay. A few people went hungry who did not need to.
epilogues.C: People remember being hungry. Many are glad you are done.
epilogues.F: The people have had enough. They never want to hear your name again.

hints.1: Each person eats 20 bushels a year. Feed everyone and more people will come.
hints.2: One person can farm 10 acres. Each acre needs 1 bushel of seed.
hints.3: Land costs less in some years. Buy when it is cheap. Sell when it costs a lot.
hints.4: Rats, sickness and bad harvests can come any time. Save some grain.
